exposure: prophylactic infrarenal abdominal aortic cross-clamping technique
cohort: The study included 31 women with histopathologically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders.
finding: The prophylactic infrarenal abdominal aortic cross-clamping technique during caesarean hysterectomy is a relatively safe procedure that may potentially control operative blood loss.
mod_finding: The technique was applied during caesarean hysterectomy, indicating a caesarean mode of birth.
